evidence.quoted_text:
base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: The current `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and then the new run directory with `mkdir` but never fsyncs `base` (nor the parent when `base` is newly created) before returning. `durable_write` on the later receipt syncs the receipt/run dir, not the base entry linking that run dir, so a power loss can lose the directory entry while the host is held. This is an implementation gap in the existing durable recovery record path; add fsync of base (and parent if created) and fail closed.
